data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 云海巡航的光剑战装展颜
data.description: 蔚蓝高空云海翻滚，阿斯特蕾亚身着西纳普斯近战战斗服，晶莹光之剑 Chrysaor 在手中流转光辉，纯白机械光翼尽展。
data.action: 悬停空中手握超振动光子剑，纯白羽翼完全展开，回头露出元气灿烂的纯真笑容
data.lighting: 高空刺目的纯净阳光照耀羽翼，光之剑刃散发金色等离子光晕
data.camera: 动态俯仰仰拍，突出宏大云海空间与战斗服机械质感
data.promptProse: Astraea soars with exhilarating freedom high above a boundless white sea of clouds under a blazing azure sky. She wears her sleek white Synapse battle bodysuit trimmed in gold, with her massive mechanical angel wings spread wide catching high-altitude sunlight. Gripping the glowing hilt of her golden photon sword Chrysaor, she turns back over her shoulder with an uninhibited, radiant grin full of heroic innocence.
data.animaCaption: Soaring above the endless cloud canopy, Astraea brandishes her glowing photon blade with a bright, triumphant smile.
